mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC rose from -11.1 in t-1w to -7.9 in t-0w, a one-week rebound that signals recovering retail demand momentum; this momentum persists over the next four weeks and lifts the 28-day mean above the prior 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -11.1 at t-1w to -7.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +15, holiday provisioning trips increase foot traffic to local commercial streets, spilling over into retail-and-recreation visits within two weeks and raising RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the prior 14 days whenever GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +15.

mechanism_narrative: The joint recovery of WORKPLACES from -25.7 to -8.9 and TRANSIT from -27.3 to -21.0 week-on-week signals returning commuter routines; this restores weekday retail footfall and raises RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises >10 points week-on-week and TRANSIT rises >5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose 16.8 points and TRANSIT rose 6.3 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES rising >10 points and TRANSIT rising >5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RESIDENTIAL from 7.0 to 3.9 week-on-week indicates people are leaving home more, which increases time spent in commercial and recreation venues and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 7.0 at t-1w to 3.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the prior 14 days when RESIDENTIAL falls more than 2 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS below zero at -5.0 indicates winter weather or outdoor avoidance, causing substitution toward indoor retail and recreation venues; this substitution raises RETAIL_REC within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than over the prior 7 days when PARKS is below zero.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT remaining below -20 at -21.0 signals persistent avoidance of public transport, limiting access to central shopping districts; this suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -21.0 at t-0w and -27.3 at t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -20.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES remaining below baseline at -8.9 means fewer daytime office workers in central districts, reducing weekday retail demand and pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains below -5.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +12 while RESIDENTIAL stays above +3, households are shifting toward essential local trips and staying home, which substitutes away from discretionary retail and lowers RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was 18.0 and RESIDENTIAL 3.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +12 and RESIDENTIAL exceeds +3.
